cover.title: You can read this street with 5 words
cover.subtitle: Swipe to decode the signs

caption: Every sign on this street is built from these five. 唐人街 is literally "Tang people street" — Chinese communities abroad named themselves after the Tang dynasty, not after any modern country, and the name stuck for a thousand years. The other four sort themselves by what you do there: 店 is a place you buy from, 馆 is a place you sit down in. So 烤鸭店 sells you the duck to take away, 川菜馆 sits you down for Sichuan food, and 酒店 — literally "wine shop" — stopped meaning tavern centuries ago and now means hotel.
